about.fullName: Students' Association of Jamia Nooriyya for Devoted Activities
about.story:
SAJDA stands for the Students' Association of Jamia Nooriyya for Devoted Activities, functioning as the central student committee of Jamia Nooriyya Arabiyya in Faizabad-Pattikkad, Kerala.

The fuller story of Sajda — its founding, mission, and the values that guide its work — belongs here in Sajda's own words. Add it through the admin panel.
